# Apply for Constellation — Environmental Project Engineer

Environmental Subject Matter Expert role on Constellation's Projects & Services team supporting new build and large capital projects across nuclear, gas, geothermal, hydro, wind, and solar facilities. Day-to-day is permitting, agency consultation, due diligence on M&A activity, and contractor management for the environmental scope of large infrastructure projects. Sits outside Scott's three named lanes — it's IC-level environmental engineering for clean-energy infrastructure, not a sustainability strategy or product role — but the underlying competencies (regulatory interpretation across multiple frameworks, multi-stakeholder project management, scientific literacy with EPC/OEM contractors and agency staff) map cleanly to Scott's PhD + Carbon Trust + Stacks Data history.

## Steps

- [ ] Tailor resume → `[[resume-constellation-environmental-project-engineer]]`
- [ ] Draft cover letter → `[[cover-letter-constellation-environmental-project-engineer]]`
- [ ] Submit application via Constellation's careers portal

# Apply for ReMA — Senior Manager, Industry Research & Insights

Applied industry research role at the trade association for the recycled materials industry, reporting to the Chief Economist. Leads sector coverage (focus on non-metals), runs multi-month research projects, builds data products and member-facing reports, and presents findings at industry events. Outside Scott's three named lanes — closer to "applied research / trade association economist" — but the topical match is unusually strong: PhD dissertation on LCA of municipal solid waste, peer-reviewed publications on US recycling/waste characterization, and 13 years running applied research with Fortune 500 manufacturers via Stacks Data and the Carbon Trust. Comp ($120–135K) is well above target.
